## TL;DR The Hold task dialog now uses the same outlined field chrome as the archive dialog, and Hold task submits with an empty reason. `POST /api/tasks/:id/hold` accepts that empty reason. `repoos hold` still requires `--reason`. The held card on the task panel drops a blank reason row and a blank byline, and its padding is even on every side. ## Work and rationale The dialog was a pair of unstyled controls: a textarea and a date input with utility classes (`input`, `min-h-20`) and no shared field border, radius, or focus treatment. The submit button stayed disabled until `reason.trim()` was non-empty, and `submit()` returned early in that case. That disagreed with the product rule that a reason is documentation, not a precondition for parking a task. The server route enforced the same rule, returning 400 with `hold requires a reason` when the body had no usable string. The CLI duplicated that check before it called the API. The note on the task was explicit: confirm the HTTP route can accept an empty reason before relaxing the UI, and leave the CLI alone. I removed the 400 only. A missing, non-string, or whitespace-only `reason` still becomes `undefined`, and `patchTaskFile` already clears `holdReason` when the patch value is nullish, so the task is held without a `hold_reason` line. An unparseable `--until` is still a 400, including when no reason is sent, because a bad date would never auto-release. `cmdHold` still prints `hold requires a --reason` and returns 1 before `ensureServer`. The comment above that check now says the CLI requirement is local and the HTTP route is optional, so the next reader does not "restore" the 400 to match the CLI. The dialog follows `ArchiveTaskDialog`: a `.field` wrapper, a label, and `textarea.ff-textarea`. The date input sits in a second `.field` so `.field input` supplies the border, radius, background, and type color. Both labels use `.field-optional`, which I added next to `.field label` in `style.css` because the previous optional styling lived only in `TaskDrawer.vue`'s scoped block and would not apply inside this dialog. `.ff-textarea` defaults to a 230px minimum, which is right for a task body and too tall for a one-line reason, so `.hold-dialog-field .ff-textarea.hold-dialog-reason` sets 96px and clears the textarea's bottom margin. Focus uses `border-color: var(--border-bright)` plus `box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--ring)` — tokens already used for focus elsewhere, no new hex colors. `submit()` emits `{ reason }` only when the trimmed text is non-empty, and `{ until }` only when a date is set. An empty submit is `{}`. The emit type and `placeHold` now type `reason` as optional so an empty hold typechecks. The button disables only while `busy` is set. The held card always rendered a `` byline, so a hold with no author, time, or auto-release date left an empty row under the title. A whitespace-only `holdReason` is truthy in Vue, so it also left a blank `

`. The template now shows the reason paragraph only when `holdReason.trim()` is non-empty, and the byline only when `holdBy`, `holdAt`, or `holdUntil` is set. The auto-release fragment no longer starts with a stray middle dot when it is the only byline part. The card copy stays "Held — automation won't start this task" and does not say "pause". Hold and pause remain different: pause is still the CLI and the running-agent stop; this card does not borrow that word when the reason is missing. Padding was `11px 12px` in a horizontal row, with 4px top margins on the reason and byline and a 6px button gap, so the text, buttons, and card edge did not share one rhythm. The card is now a column with 16px padding on every side, 12px between the copy block and the buttons, and 8px between title, reason, and byline. Horizontal margin is `12px 22px`, in line with the drawer content inset, so the amber fill is not flush with the panel edge. The narrow-viewport media query that only flipped the row to a column is gone because the column is the layout at every width. Button wrapping stays on `.held-panel-actions`. `user-docs/cli.md` now says the dialog and `POST /api/tasks/:id/hold` accept a missing reason, and that `repoos hold` still requires `--reason`. The usage line in the help text is unchanged. Tests: `task-transitions` expects 200 and `holdReason === undefined` for `{}`. `held-task-ui` expects the shared classes, an enabled Hold task button, an `{}` emit, then a second emit that still carries the reason and a parsed until-date. `task-drawer-held` expects the hold POST body to be `{}`, and a held task whose reason is only spaces and whose byline fields are absent to render no `

`, no ``, and no "pause". Declared shots: the Hold dialog opened from the review-with-branch drawer fixture (`click` on `[data-test-id="hold-task"]`, highlight `.cc-modal`), and the held card via `drawer:held` (highlight `.held-panel`). Both use target `default` and `/work?task=9999`. ## Approaches tried I first assumed the server already treated the reason as optional, because the task said to check that before changing the button. It did not: the route and the CLI both refused. Relaxing only the button would have made Hold task fail at the API with the old 400. The CLI guard stays in `cmdHold` so shell users still document a hold; the route is the one the dialog calls. I considered reusing `ArchiveTaskDialog`'s delete-confirm shell for the whole modal. The hold dialog already uses `ui/dialog/*` and `.cc-modal`, which is the shared confirm shell this screen shipped with. Restyling the fields inside it avoids a second modal layout for the same action. A global focus ring on every `.ff-textarea:focus` would have changed archive, new-task, and commit fields in the same patch. The ring is limited to `.hold-dialog-field`. ## Challenges and blockers `bunx vitest` on the Vue specs failed with "Install @vitejs/plugin-vue" because that invocation did not load the UI project's Vue plugin. `bun run test --` the same files passed (the hold route file included). That was an invocation miss, not a syntax error in the dialog. `repoos update --shots` writes the board on the main checkout when the command runs inside a linked worktree. That is how board commands are specified (`boardRoot()`). The shots section therefore lands on the canonical task file. This branch does not hand-edit `work/1033-*.md`. ## Key learnings Empty and whitespace are the same input on this route: both trim to "no reason", and the card must treat them the same or a blank row comes back. The held card's byline was a separate empty row from the reason; hiding only the `

` would not have satisfied the acceptance check. CLI and HTTP do not have to share the required-field rule when the task says the command stays strict and the dialog does not. ## Generated change summary Base tree: `d9c92fd91b025e41abe95e15d098b6c618316a71` Source tree: `f125ce2c26c693df3985947cb0ae70c5f94772f4` - M src/commands/control-api.ts: +3 / −3 - M src/server/routes/tasks.ts: +5 / −11 - M src/ui-app/src/components/HoldTaskDialog.vue: +15 / −13 - M src/ui-app/src/components/TaskDrawer.vue: +5 / −4 - M src/ui-app/src/style.css: +37 / −15 - M src/ui-app/tests/held-task-ui.test.ts: +9 / −6 - M src/ui-app/tests/task-drawer-held.test.ts: +23 / −5 - M src/ui-app/tests/task-transitions.test.ts: +6 / −5 - M user-docs/cli.md: +3 / −1
